technique_name: How is Deep Learning different from Machine Learning?
description: Deep learning and machine learning are both AI-based technologies, but they differ in how they process data. Machine learning relies on numerical data such as structured data or even unstructured data, whereas deep learning takes advantage of layered neural networks to process data. Machine learning algorithms take data sets, recognize patterns, and then output predictions.
